name: Ripple Tank
desc: A coarse-grid wave-equation ripple tank where two-to-four vibrating dippers radiate expanding circular wavefronts that cross into shimmering interference caustics while bass drops splash fresh rings, rendered as blue-green caustic water, ironbow thermal, oscilloscope phosphor, blueprint contour, or liquid mercury chrome.

energy.doc: wave amplitude + display contrast + caustic-shimmer brightness

density.doc: source count (2-4) + drop cadence + contour band count + highlight richness

speed.doc: dipper oscillation + orbit + drift + sim substeps rate

scale.doc: ripple wavelength / ring spacing (bigger = longer, wider waves)

hue.doc: water/palette base hue (thermal & mercury are false-color, hue-agnostic)

style.doc: render philosophy: blue-green caustic water / ironbow thermal false-color / oscilloscope phosphor iso-traces / blueprint schematic contour lines / liquid mercury chrome

act.doc: multi-minute program: ripples = calm drifting interference / storm = agitated tank, more & bigger drops, longer sustain / tide = sources slowly converge and the swell breathes

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg; lower leaves translucent feedback trails)
